# Rackets Academy

> Padel, pickleball and tennis club with two locations in Valais, Switzerland: Salgesch near Sierre (padel, 3 indoor pickleball courts, 2 indoor tennis courts, spa) and Sion (padel). Court booking, coaching for kids and adults, events, kids holiday camps, Ski &Padel weekends, racket shop, spa and bar. Website in English, French and German.

## Key facts
- Locations: Littenstrasse 30, 3970 Salgesch · Route de Préjeux 16, 1950 Sion
- Opening hours: daily 07:00–23:30
- Court booking: online via Playtomic (live availability for both locations)
- Coaching: group courses for kids and adults from CHF 19 per session; private lessons from CHF 55 per person
- Beginner course (cours d'initiation): every Saturday at 10:00 in Sion, bookable on Playtomic
- Racket shop: official reseller of Babolat, Wilson and Siux. Any racket can be tested for CHF 10; the fee is credited when you buy. Pick-up in Salgesch or Sion.
- Gift vouchers: CHF 20 per voucher (one evening game), valid without time limit, bought online
- Membership: Rackets+, free membership with rewards, via WhatsApp
- Contact: phil@racketsacademy.ch · WhatsApp +41 77 278 01 15 (Salgesch) · +41 76 291 43 69 (Sion)

- [Events](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/events.html): all upcoming tournaments, open plays and social events in Salgesch and Sion, with live places and Playtomic links

- [Pickleball](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/pickleball.html): 3 indoor pickleball courts in Salgesch (only there)
- [Tennis](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/tennis.html): 2 indoor tennis courts in Salgesch, between Sion and Brig (only there)
- [Kids holiday camps](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/kids-camp.html): day camps 2027 in Salgesch, 14:00–17:00, CHF 250 per week, bookable online
- [Kids birthday parties](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/kids-birthday.html): in Salgesch
- [Padel +Dine](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/fr/padel-dine.html): padel tournament with dinner party in Salgesch; next date to be announced
- [Shop](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/shop.html): gift vouchers and padel rackets (one page per racket under /rackets/)
- [Padel racket guide](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/padel-racket-guide.html): which padel racket suits me; shape, hardness and weight explained, picks for beginners, control, all-round and power from the rackets in stock; every racket can be tested for 10 CHF
- [Siux padel rackets in Switzerland](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/siux-switzerland.html): official Siux reseller; all Siux models with live stock and prices in CHF, no customs, delivery anywhere in Switzerland in 1–2 working days, test for 10 CHF
- [Ski &Padel weekends](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/ski-and-padel.html): all-inclusive Ski &Padel weekends in Salgesch, Valais (Switzerland), 18–21 and 25–28 Feb 2027; skiing in Crans-Montana, Leukerbad, Grimentz-Zinal or the 4 Vallées depending on conditions, padel, spa, lodging, breakfast and dinner; individual place 1199 CHF, group of 4 999 CHF per person; bookable online
- [Spa](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/spa-and-sauna.html): sauna, hammam and jacuzzi in Salgesch near Sierre
- [Companies](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/company.html): company events, sponsoring and corporate discount (15 % before 17:30)
- [Membership](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/rackets-plus.html): Rackets+, free, with rewards
- [About](https://www.racketsacademy.ch/about.html): team and story
